celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ﴾ the Exalted praised Himself with this, and what is meant by it is extolling [Him] through its content, namely the affirmation of praise, which is describing with beauty, as belonging to Allah the Exalted ﴿الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ as dominion and as creation ﴿وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ﴾ as in this world; His friends praise Him when they enter Paradise ﴿وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ in His action ﴿الْخَبِيرُ﴾ of His creation

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ﴾ enters ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ such as water and other things ﴿وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا﴾ such as plants and other things ﴿وَمَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ﴾ of provision and other things ﴿وَمَا يَعْرُجُ﴾ ascends ﴿فِيهَا﴾ of deeds and other things ﴿وَهُوَ الرَّحِيمُ﴾ to His friends ﴿الْغَفُورُ﴾ to them

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَأْتِينَا السَّاعَةُ﴾ the Resurrection ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them ﴿بَلَى وَرَبِّي لَتَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ﴾ in the genitive as an adjective (ṣifa), and in the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject); and [also read] «عَلَّامِ» in the genitive ﴿لَا يَعْزُبُ﴾ is hidden ﴿عَنْهُ مِثْقَالُ﴾ the weight ﴿ذَرَّةٍ﴾ of the smallest ant ﴿فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا أَصْغَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَلَا أَكْبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ clear, namely the Preserved Tablet

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ﴾ in it ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ﴾ goodly, in Paradise

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ سَعَوْا فِي﴾ invalidating ﴿آيَاتِنَا﴾ the Qur'an ﴿مُعْجِزِينَ﴾ and in one reading, here and in what follows, [مُعَاجِزِينَ], i.e. supposing Us incapable, or racing against Us so that they would escape Us, because they think there is no resurrection and no punishment ﴿أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِنْ رِجْزٍ﴾ the worst punishment ﴿أَلِيمٍ﴾ painful; in the genitive, and in the nominative [أَلِيمٌ], as an adjective of «رِجْزٍ» or of «عَذَابٌ»

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿وَيَرَى﴾ knows ﴿الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ﴾ the believers among the People of the Book, such as ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām and his companions ﴿الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ i.e. the Qur'an ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (faṣl) ﴿الْحَقَّ وَيَهْدِي إِلَى صِرَاطِ﴾ the path ﴿الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ﴾ i.e. Allah, the Possessor of might, the Praised

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ i.e. some of them said to others by way of expressing astonishment ﴿هَلْ نَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى رَجُلٍ﴾ he is Muhammad ﴿يُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ informs you that you, ﴿إِذَا مُزِّقْتُمْ﴾ are cut to pieces ﴿كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ﴾ in the sense of «تَمْزِيقٍ» (tearing apart) ﴿إِنَّكُمْ لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ﴾.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿أَفْتَرَى﴾ with the hamza vowelled with fatḥa, for interrogation, and by it the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) is dispensed with ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا﴾ in that ﴿أَمْ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ﴾ madness, through which he imagines that. The Exalted said: ﴿بَلِ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ which comprises the resurrection and the punishment ﴿فِي الْعَذَابِ﴾ in it ﴿وَالضَّلَالِ الْبَعِيدِ﴾ from the truth in this world

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿أَفَلَمْ يَرَوْا﴾ look ﴿إِلَى مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ﴾ what is above them and what is beneath them ﴿مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِنْ نَشَأْ نَخْسِفْ بِهِمُ الْأَرْضَ أَوْ نُسْقِطْ عَلَيْهِمْ كِسْفًا﴾ with the sīn vowelless, and with fatḥa [كِسَفًا]: a piece ﴿مِنَ السَّمَاءِ﴾ and in one reading the three verbs are with yāʾ ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which is seen ﴿لَآيَةً لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ﴾ turning back to his Lord, indicating Allah's power over the resurrection and whatever He wills

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُدَ مِنَّا فَضْلًا﴾ prophethood and a scripture, and We said: ﴿يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِي﴾ echo ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ with glorification ﴿وَالطَّيْرَ﴾ in the accusative, conjoined to the position (maḥall) of «الْجِبَالِ», i.e. and We called them to glorify with him ﴿وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ﴾ so in his hand it was like dough; and We said

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿أَنِ اعْمَلْ﴾ from it ﴿سَابِغَاتٍ﴾ complete coats of mail which the wearer trails on the ground ﴿وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ﴾ i.e. the weaving of coats of mail; their maker is called sarrād; i.e. make it such that its rings are proportionate ﴿وَاعْمَلُوا﴾ i.e. the family of David along with him ﴿صَالِحًا إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ﴾ so I will recompense you for it

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿وَ﴾ We subjected ﴿لِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ﴾ and the reading in the nominative is with «تَسْخِيرُ» (subjection) implied ﴿غُدُوُّهَا﴾ its travel from ghadwa, meaning morning, until the sun's decline ﴿شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا﴾ its travel from the sun's decline until sunset ﴿شَهْرٌ﴾ i.e. a month's journey ﴿وَأَسَلْنَا﴾ We melted ﴿لَهُ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِ﴾ i.e. copper; it was made to flow for three days with their nights like the flowing of water, and what people work [in copper] to this day is from what was given to Solomon ﴿وَمِنَ الْجِنِّ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ﴾ by the command ﴿رَبِّهِ وَمَنْ يَزِغْ﴾ deviates ﴿مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا﴾ to him to obey him ﴿نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ﴾ the Fire in the Hereafter; and it is said: in this world, in that an angel strikes him with a whip of it, a blow that burns him

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ لَهُ مَا يَشَاءُ مِنْ مَحَارِيبَ﴾ elevated buildings ascended by steps ﴿وَتَمَاثِيلَ﴾ plural of timthāl, which is anything you have made in the likeness of something, i.e. images of copper, glass and marble; taking images was not forbidden in his law ﴿وَجِفَانٍ﴾ plural of jafna (large bowl) ﴿كَالْجَوَابِ﴾ plural of jābiya, which is a large basin; a thousand men would gather around the bowl eating from it ﴿وَقُدُورٍ رَاسِيَاتٍ﴾ fixed, having legs, not moving from their places, made from the mountains in Yemen, ascended by ladders; and We said: ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ O ﴿آلَ دَاوُدَ﴾ in obedience to Allah ﴿شُكْرًا﴾ to Him for what He has given you ﴿وَقَلِيلٌ مِنْ عِبَادِيَ الشَّكُورُ﴾ the one who acts in obedience to Me in gratitude for My blessing

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ﴾ on Solomon ﴿الْمَوْتَ﴾ i.e. he died, and remained standing on his staff for a year, dead, while the jinn went on doing those arduous works as was their habit, not perceiving his death, until the termite ate his staff and he fell down dead ﴿مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَى مَوْتِهِ إِلَّا دَابَّةُ الْأَرْضِ﴾ a maṣdar (verbal noun) of «أُرِضَتِ الْخَشَبَةُ», with the verb passive, [meaning] the termite ate it ﴿تَأْكُلُ مِنْسَأَتَهُ﴾ with hamza, and without it, with an alif: his staff, because with it one drives away (yunsaʾ), i.e. one chases and restrains ﴿فَلَمَّا خَرَّ﴾ dead ﴿تَبَيَّنَتِ الْجِنُّ﴾ it became revealed to them ﴿أَنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa), [i.e.] «أَنَّهُمْ» ﴿لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ الْغَيْبَ﴾ and part of it is what was hidden from them of Solomon's death ﴿مَا لَبِثُوا فِي الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ﴾ the arduous work imposed on them, because they thought him alive, contrary to their claim to know the unseen. And it was known to be a year by calculating what the termite ate of the staff after his death, a day and a night for example.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿لَقَدْ كَانَ لِسَبَإٍ﴾ with and without nunation (ṣarf): a tribe of the Arabs named after an ancestor of theirs ﴿فِي مَسْكَنِهِمْ﴾ in Yemen ﴿آيَةٌ﴾ indicating the power of Allah the Exalted ﴿جَنَّتَانِ﴾ a badal (substitute) ﴿عَنْ يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ﴾ on the right of their valley and its left; and it was said to them: ﴿كُلُوا مِنْ رِزْقِ رَبِّكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لَهُ﴾ for the blessing He provided you in the land of Sabaʾ ﴿بَلْدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ﴾ in which there is no salty marsh, no mosquito, no fly, no flea, no scorpion and no snake; a stranger would pass through it with lice in his clothes, and they would die because of the goodness of its air ﴿وَ﴾ Allah is ﴿رَبٌّ غَفُورٌ﴾

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿فَأَعْرَضُوا﴾ from thanking Him and disbelieved ﴿فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ الْعَرِمِ﴾ plural of ʿarima, which is what holds back water, a construction or the like, until the time it is needed; i.e. the flood of their valley which was held back by what has been mentioned, and it drowned their two gardens and their property ﴿وَبَدَّلْنَاهُمْ بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَيْ﴾ the dual of «ذَوَات», a singular, according to the original form ﴿أُكُلِ خَمْطٍ﴾ bitter and foul; with «أُكُل», meaning "what is eaten", in iḍāfa (genitive construct), and without it [أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍ], and to it is conjoined ﴿وَأَثْلٍ وَشَيْءٍ مِنْ سِدْرٍ قَلِيلٍ﴾

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ the substitution ﴿جَزَيْنَاهُمْ بِمَا كَفَرُوا﴾ for their disbelief ﴿وَهَلْ يُجَازَى إِلَّا الْكَفُورُ﴾ with yāʾ, and with nūn together with kasra on the zāy and «الْكَفُورَ» in the accusative [نُجَازِي إِلَّا الْكَفُورَ], i.e. none is called strictly to account except him

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ between Sabaʾ, who were in Yemen, ﴿وَبَيْنَ الْقُرَى الَّتِي بَارَكْنَا فِيهَا﴾ with water and trees, and they are the towns of Syria (al-Shām) to which they used to travel for trade ﴿قُرًى ظَاهِرَةً﴾ connected one to another from Yemen to Syria ﴿وَقَدَّرْنَا فِيهَا السَّيْرَ﴾ such that they would take their midday rest in one and spend the night in another until the end of their journey, and in it they did not need to carry provisions and water; i.e. and We said: ﴿سِيرُوا فِيهَا لَيَالِيَ وَأَيَّامًا آمِنِينَ﴾ not fearing by night or by day

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿فَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا بَعِّدْ﴾ and in one reading [بَاعِدْ] ﴿بَيْنَ أَسْفَارِنَا﴾ to Syria; make them deserts, so that they might vaunt themselves over the poor by riding mounts and carrying provisions and water; so they were ungrateful for the blessing ﴿وَظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ by disbelief ﴿فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ﴾ for those after them in that ﴿وَمَزَّقْنَاهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ﴾ We dispersed them in the lands with every kind of dispersal ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ which has been mentioned ﴿لَآيَاتٍ﴾ lessons ﴿لِكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ﴾ [restraining himself] from sins ﴿شَكُورٍ﴾ for blessings

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَ﴾ without and with doubling (tashdīd) [صَدَّقَ] ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers, among them Sabaʾ ﴿إِبْلِيسُ ظَنَّهُ﴾ that they would follow him through his leading them astray ﴿فَاتَّبَعُوهُ﴾ so «صَدَقَ», without doubling, [means he was truthful] in his supposition, or «صَدَّقَ», with doubling, [means he confirmed] his supposition, i.e. he found it true ﴿إِلَّا﴾ in the sense of «لَكِنْ» (but) ﴿فَرِيقًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ [«مِنْ»] for explication (bayān), i.e. they are the believers; they did not follow him

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ﴾ empowerment ﴿إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ﴾ with a knowledge of manifestation ﴿مَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِالْآخِرَةِ مِمَّنْ هُوَ مِنْهَا فِي شَكٍّ﴾ and so We recompense each of the two ﴿وَرَبُّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ حَفِيظٌ﴾ watchful

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ O Muhammad, to the disbelievers of Mecca: ﴿ادْعُوا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ﴾ i.e. claimed them to be gods ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ i.e. other than Him, so that they may benefit you, as you claim. The Exalted said about them: ﴿لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِثْقَالَ﴾ the weight ﴿ذَرَّةٍ﴾ of good or evil ﴿فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا لَهُمْ فِيهِمَا مِنْ شِرْكٍ﴾ partnership ﴿وَمَا لَهُ﴾ the Exalted ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ of the gods ﴿مِنْ ظَهِيرٍ﴾ helper

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَلَا تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهُ﴾ the Exalted; a rebuttal of their saying that their gods intercede with Him ﴿إِلَّا لِمَنْ أَذِنَ﴾ with the hamza vowelled with fatḥa and with ḍamma ﴿لَهُ﴾ in it ﴿حَتَّى إِذَا فَزَّعَ﴾ with the verb active and passive [فُزِّعَ] ﴿عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ the fright was removed from them by the permission for it ﴿قَالُوا﴾ some said to others, rejoicing: ﴿مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ about it ﴿قَالُوا﴾ the saying ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ i.e. He has given permission for it ﴿وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ﴾ above His creation by subjugation ﴿الْكَبِيرُ﴾ the Great

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿قُلْ مَنْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ﴾ the rain ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ the plants ﴿قُلِ اللَّهُ﴾ if they do not say it, there is no other answer ﴿وَإِنَّا أَوْ إِيَّاكُمْ﴾ i.e. one of the two parties ﴿لَعَلَى هُدًى أَوْ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُبِينٍ﴾ clear; in the vagueness there is gentleness towards them, inviting to faith if they are granted success in it

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿قُلْ لَا تُسْأَلُونَ عَمَّا أَجْرَمْنَا﴾ sinned ﴿وَلَا نُسْأَلُ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ because we are free of you

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا﴾ on the Day of Resurrection ﴿ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ﴾ judges ﴿بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ and He will admit those in the right to Paradise and those in falsehood to the Fire ﴿وَهُوَ الْفَتَّاحُ﴾ the Judge ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ of what He judges by

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿قُلْ أَرُونِيَ﴾ inform me of ﴿الَّذِينَ أَلْحَقْتُمْ بِهِ شُرَكَاءَ﴾ in worship ﴿كَلَّا﴾ a deterrent to them from believing in a partner for Him ﴿بَلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ﴾ prevailing over His affair ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ in His governance of His creation; so He can have no partner in His dominion

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا كَافَّةً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «النَّاسِ», placed first for emphasis ﴿لِلنَّاسِ بَشِيرًا﴾ giving the believers good tidings of Paradise ﴿وَنَذِيرًا﴾ warning the disbelievers of punishment ﴿وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ذَلِكَ﴾

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَى هَذَا الْوَعْدُ﴾ of punishment ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ﴾ in it

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿قُلْ لَكُمْ مِيعَادُ يَوْمٍ لَا تَسْتَأْخِرُونَ عَنْهُ سَاعَةً وَلَا تَسْتَقْدِمُونَ﴾ before it; and it is the Day of Resurrection

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ among the people of Mecca ﴿لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ بِهَذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَلَا بِالَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ﴾ i.e. what preceded it, such as the Torah and the Gospel, which point to the resurrection, because they denied it. The Exalted said about them: ﴿وَلَوْ تَرَى﴾ O Muhammad ﴿إِذِ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ the disbelievers ﴿مَوْقُوفُونَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ الْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا﴾ the followers ﴿لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ the chiefs ﴿لَوْلَا أَنْتُمْ﴾ [had you not] turned us away from faith ﴿لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ in the Prophet.

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿قَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَاكُمْ عَنِ الْهُدَى بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَكُمْ﴾ No! ﴿بَلْ كُنْتُمْ مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ in yourselves

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ اسْتُضْعِفُوا لِلَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا بَلْ مَكْرُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ﴾ i.e. plotting against us by you in them ﴿إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَا أَنْ نَكْفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُ أَنْدَادًا﴾ partners ﴿وَأَسَرُّوا﴾ i.e. the two parties ﴿النَّدَامَةَ﴾ over abandoning faith in Him ﴿لَمَّا رَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ﴾ i.e. each hid it from his companion for fear of reproach ﴿وَجَعَلْنَا الْأَغْلَالَ فِي أَعْنَاقِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ in the Fire ﴿هَلْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا﴾ the recompense of ﴿مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ in this world

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا﴾ its chiefs who live in luxury ﴿إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهِ كَافِرُونَ﴾

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَالًا وَأَوْلَادًا﴾ than those who believed ﴿وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ﴾

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ﴾ expands it ﴿لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ as a test ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ restricts it for whom He wills, as a trial ﴿وَلَكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca ﴿لَا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ that

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ بِالَّتِي تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِنْدَنَا زُلْفَى﴾ nearness, i.e. bringing near ﴿إِلَّا﴾ [meaning] «لَكِنْ» (but) ﴿مَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَاءُ الضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا﴾ i.e. the recompense of the deed, the good deed for example being [rewarded] tenfold or more ﴿وَهُمْ فِي الْغُرُفَاتِ﴾ of Paradise ﴿آمِنُونَ﴾ from death and other things; and in one reading [الْغُرْفَةُ], in the sense of the plural

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِي آيَاتِنَا﴾ the Qur'an, to invalidate it ﴿مُعَاجِزِينَ﴾ Us, supposing Us incapable and that they will escape Us ﴿أُولَئِكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ﴾

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ﴾ expands it ﴿لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ﴾ as a test ﴿وَيَقْدِرُ﴾ restricts it ﴿لَهُ﴾ after the expansion, or for whom He wills, as a trial ﴿وَمَا أَنْفَقْتُمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ in good ﴿فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ﴾ it is said that every person provides for his dependants, i.e. from the provision of Allah.

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿وَ﴾ mention ﴿يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًا﴾ i.e. the idolaters; [also read يَحْشُرُهُمْ] ﴿ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ أَهَؤُلَاءِ إِيَّاكُمْ﴾ [also read يَقُولُ]; with both hamzas pronounced fully, with the first changed into yāʾ, and with it dropped ﴿كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ﴾

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿قَالُوا سُبْحَانَكَ﴾ declaring You free of any partner ﴿أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِنْ دُونِهِمْ﴾ i.e. there is no friendship between us and them from our side ﴿بَلْ﴾ for transition (intiqāl) ﴿كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ الْجِنَّ﴾ the devils, i.e. they obeyed them in their worshipping us ﴿أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِهِمْ مُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ believing them in what they tell them. The Exalted said:

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ﴾ i.e. some of those worshipped for some of the worshippers ﴿نَفْعًا﴾ intercession ﴿وَلَا ضَرًّا﴾ punishment ﴿وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا﴾ disbelieved ﴿ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّتِي كُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ﴾

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَإِذَا تُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا﴾ the Qur'an ﴿بَيِّنَاتٍ﴾ clear, on the tongue of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ﴿قَالُوا مَا هَذَا إِلَّا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُكُمْ﴾ of idols ﴿وَقَالُوا مَا هَذَا﴾ i.e. the Qur'an ﴿إِلَّا إِفْكٌ﴾ a lie ﴿مُفْتَرًى﴾ fabricated against Allah ﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلْحَقِّ﴾ the Qur'an ﴿لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ إِنْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿هَذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ clear. The Exalted said:

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿وَمَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنْ كُتُبٍ يَدْرُسُونَهَا وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ﴾ so on what basis did they deny you?

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿وَكَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا﴾ i.e. these ﴿مِعْشَارَ مَا آتَيْنَاهُمْ﴾ of strength, long life and abundant wealth ﴿فَكَذَّبُوا رُسُلِي﴾ to them ﴿فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ﴾ My disapproval of them through punishment and destruction, i.e. it fell in its proper place

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَعِظُكُمْ بِوَاحِدَةٍ﴾ it is ﴿أَنْ تَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ﴾ for His sake ﴿مَثْنَى﴾ i.e. two by two ﴿وَفُرَادَى﴾ one by one ﴿ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا﴾ and so know that ﴿مَا بِصَاحِبِكُمْ﴾ Muhammad ﴿مِنْ جِنَّةٍ﴾ madness ﴿إِنْ﴾ [meaning] «مَا» (not) ﴿هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ لَكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ﴾ i.e. before ﴿عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ﴾ in the Hereafter, if you disobey him

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ to them ﴿مَا سَأَلْتُكُمْ﴾ for the warning and the conveying ﴿مِنْ أَجْرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ﴾ i.e. I do not ask you any wage for it ﴿إِنْ أَجْرِيَ﴾ my reward is not ﴿إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ﴾ aware; He knows my truthfulness

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ casts it to His prophets ﴿عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ﴾ what is hidden from His creation in the heavens and the earth.

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿قُلْ جَاءَ الْحَقُّ﴾ Islam ﴿وَمَا يُبْدِئُ الْبَاطِلُ﴾ disbelief ﴿وَمَا يُعِيدُ﴾ i.e. no trace of it has remained

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿قُلْ إِنْ ضَلَلْتُ﴾ from the truth ﴿فَإِنَّمَا أَضِلُّ عَلَى نَفْسِي﴾ i.e. the sin of my going astray is upon it ﴿وَإِنِ اهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِي إِلَيَّ رَبِّي﴾ of the Qur'an and wisdom ﴿إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ﴾ of supplication ﴿قَرِيبٌ﴾

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿وَلَوْ تَرَى﴾ O Muhammad ﴿إِذْ فَزِعُوا﴾ at the resurrection, you would see a tremendous matter ﴿فَلَا فَوْتَ﴾ for them from Us, i.e. they will not escape Us ﴿وَأُخِذُوا مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ﴾ i.e. the graves

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿وَقَالُوا آمَنَّا بِهِ﴾ in Muhammad, or the Qur'an ﴿وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ﴾ with wāw, and with hamza in its place: i.e. taking hold of faith ﴿مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ﴾ from its place, since they are in the Hereafter and its place is this world

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا بِهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ in this world ﴿وَيَقْذِفُونَ﴾ throw ﴿بِالْغَيْبِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ﴾ i.e. with what is hidden from their knowledge with a distant hiddenness, in that they said of the Prophet "a sorcerer, a poet, a soothsayer", and of the Qur'an "sorcery, poetry, soothsaying"

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ﴾ of faith, i.e. its acceptance ﴿كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِمْ﴾ those like them in disbelief ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ i.e. before them ﴿إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا فِي شَكٍّ مُرِيبٍ﴾ casting them into suspicion regarding what they have now believed in, and they paid no heed to its proofs in this world.
